what_happened: The job "time workspace tests once and fix the single slowest test cause" failed. The producer made no change. Its report was sent back for problems and still did not report two acceptance criteria as met. The first criterion asked for a CHANGELOG.md entry listing the ten slowest test binaries with "finished in" times from one full run of the base, plus the slowest tests inside the slowest binary. The second asked for either before and after times showing the changed binary at least 30% faster, with whole-run times, or an explanation of why the biggest cause cannot be fixed without losing coverage, with no code changes. The producer produced neither a measurement entry nor a stated reason, and recorded no explanation for the empty run.
cause: The request joined two dependent steps, a full timed workspace test run and a code fix chosen from its result, in one producer run with one fixed deadline and budget. A full workspace test run is long and its outcome is unknown beforehand. Nothing split measurement from the fix, nothing checked at the start that the run fits the limits, and the producer has no required way to record a partial result or a reason for stopping. When the run did not finish, the producer had nothing to write and no reason to report. The first failure was found only at the final verdict.
prevention: Treat measure-then-fix requests as two stages. First a measurement job whose only deliverable is the timings entry, which the producer must write incrementally, for example by saving the raw per-binary timings file as soon as the run finishes. A check before the final verdict must confirm the entry holds real numbers or an explicit reason. The fix job is then planned from those recorded numbers, with its own before and after criterion. Any producer that ends with an empty diff must be required to record the reason: blocked, timed out or already done.
proposed_request: Time the workspace tests once and record the result. Run the full workspace test suite once on the base. Add one entry to CHANGELOG.md listing the ten slowest test binaries with their 'finished in' times, and the five slowest tests inside the slowest binary. Change only CHANGELOG.md. If the full run cannot finish within the job limits, write the entry with the partial timings that were collected and state exactly where and why the run stopped. Do not change any code in this job. A follow-up job will fix the slowest cause from these numbers.
